stages.kind_hint: Every stage belongs to one of the four scopes: New · Booked · Service done · Cancelled. The scope drives how the system treats it — e.g. a stage under the "Cancelled" scope counts as a cancellation. These four base names are fixed.

warning.title: The system runs on four fixed main stages
warning.intro: Any stage you add must fall under one of these and follow its criteria:

criteria.new: New: someone who hasn't confirmed their booking yet
criteria.confirmed: Booked: booked but hasn't received the service yet
criteria.completed: Service done: showed up and received the service
criteria.cancelled: Cancelled: cancelled the booking for good

new.correct: "Awaiting first contact" — still hasn't confirmed the booking
